problems_and_friction: No protocol was provided, so tooling had to be discovered: clan --help plus clan agent-help gave the full fork/merge/pack-html workflow quickly. The main uncertainty was whether pack-html's frontmatter 'structured' block would replace or merge-patch shared/data.yaml; I packed and then verified via a key listing that all three specialist blocks survived alongside my synthesis (they did, so no recovery needed). Reading branch namespace data directly was not obviously supported by clan read, so I merged first and read the folded shared data, which worked and saved a step.
context_understood: Synthesize three parallel specialist .clan branches (market research, risk, adoption) for Brightline's CRM selection into one final.clan carrying all contributions plus a costed HubSpot recommendation (EUR 45.5k year-1), a 3-phase rollout, an executive summary, explicit disagreement resolutions, and a polished human-readable HTML view.
